title: Unique Roasted Polish Potato Casserole
description: A dense and comforting lacto-vegetarian Polish dish featuring roasted potatoes and vanilla sugar, made with air-fry technology for a crispy exterior and fluffy interior. This casserole is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes with 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Air-fry the potatoes in batches until they are golden brown and crispy, about 10-12 minutes per batch.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sour cream, shredded cheddar cheese, and vanilla sugar.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of air-fried potatoes, followed by a layer of the sautéed onion and garlic, and finally a layer of the sour cream mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of the sour cream mixture on top.
Bake the casserole in a preheated oven at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
